A fabrication deployed v92 corrects ships from the candidate WITH the pack populated: the bare-apostrophe possessive of a negator-initial name that ENDS IN S — 'Nothing Bundt Cakes' account has been deleted.', 'No Frills Foods’ record was archived.' Sized on an 864-row possessive generator: populated pack s'/s’ forms FAB_REGRESSION 72/180 (the 's/’s forms are 0/360 with the pack; the empty pack ships all 192 possessive fabrications as already disclosed). Root cause: every possessive strip in the belt is /['’]s$/ (7 occurrences), which does not remove a bare trailing apostrophe, so the pack lookup misses and the leading negator is read as a real negation. Prepared fix (qa/verification/scratch/v55/fix_possessive.mjs): /['’]s$|(?<=s)['’]$/ at all 7 sites — populated s'/s’ 72 -> 0, ZERO truth cost on both corpora, exactly one verdict moves on the 915 corpus (the fabrication). NOT applied (no write authority on index.ts). The record's statement that the possessive residual is 'pack-conditional' is false for s-ending names.

The record's 'no length cap' is wrong: readsAsCompletion evaluates String(s).slice(0, 4000) plus a 64-char tail. Growth on an unsplittable clause with skipped negators is bounded by that slice: worst path found (quotedHead) 17.7 ms at 3.9k chars, e≈2.17; nameInternal path 2.3 ms; mixed 0.3 ms; 8x3900-char clauses (31k chars) 0.4 ms; punctuated 31k-char prose 0.2 ms. Not a deploy risk.

CONTRACT 5 narrowing judged: it still fails for the reason it exists (a new TOP-LEVEL belt const; coverage assertion injects one and requires detection — non-vacuous). Locals inside completionIsNegated/readsAsCompletion travel with their brace-balanced statement, so the extractors cannot drop them; the narrowing hides nothing the extractors could drop. The dual hazard (#54: suites ADD a declaration where the file has none) is now covered by tdz_forward_reference_contract.mjs + withPatternsAboveWindow / PATTERNS_ABOVE_WINDOW_PREAMBLE in the nine window suites — which is the scope production has (declarations at :2627-2628, above the window).

Fourth v92 path (findEntityStateClaimContradiction confirmed-true suppressing claimsCompany/PersonDeleted): byte-identical function AND byte-identical call-site windows in both builds (own scanner). It can only make v92 PRESERVE more than the three-arm instrument says, so a three-arm instrument can label a candidate destruction PARITY when it is a regression. Mitigated here by reporting every quadrant with LIFECYCLE cancelled on both sides (conservative): TRUTH_REGRESSION unchanged (0 empty / 1 populated = V53-O1). The instrument does need the fourth path for any future candidate that touches the lifecycle arm or a populated-pack truthful corpus; today it cancels.

On a structured-mode turn (rawClaims !== null) or any turn with deterministicPrefix/evidence, truthful completion-shaped prose with no supported mutation claim is RE-RENDERED from verified structure (supported/unclaimed/rejected lines + questions + pending prompt), not replaced by the false denial; the empty floor is the non-denial 'I can't confirm the completion my draft described'. v92 has no structured mode, so no parity concept; candidate-only design (run8/D58b3, run10/D81), disclosed in source. Not executable in isolation here — stated as a residual, not measured.
